description: Inngest event-processing layer: the Inngest client, the public webhook route, and the 7 Inngest functions (one per event) that consume the service/templates/PDF from FEAT-001. Each function loads the recipient profile, checks opt-in preferences, sends to each opted-in channel inside its own step.run() for retry granularity, and logs every attempt to notifications_log. The order.confirmed function also generates the PDF invoice and attaches it to the email. CRITICAL: use the installed Inngest 4.24.0 2-arg createFunction signature with `triggers` inside the options object, NOT the spec's outdated 3-arg form.
steps: Create lib/inngest/client.ts exporting `export const inngest = new Inngest({ id: 'kartiva' })` (import { Inngest } from 'inngest'). It auto-reads INNGEST_EVENT_KEY and INNGEST_SIGNING_KEY from process.env — do not pass them explicitly.

Create app/api/inngest/route.ts: `import { serve } from 'inngest/next'; import { inngest } from '@/lib/inngest/client'; import { functions } from '@/lib/inngest/functions'; export const { GET, POST, PUT } = serve({ client: inngest, functions });`. This route is publicly accessible (no auth); the existing middleware passes /api through without redirecting.

Create lib/inngest/functions/ as one file per event, plus an index.ts barrel exporting the `functions` array passed to serve(). Each function uses the INSTALLED 2-arg form: `inngest.createFunction({ id: '...', retries: 3, triggers: [{ event: 'notification/...' }] }, async ({ event, step }) => {...})`. In each handler, read `event.data` for the payload (userId, orderId, otp, amount, etc.).

Create lib/inngest/functions/welcome.ts for event 'notification/welcome' (payload: { userId }). step.run('load-profile') to load the profile; if profile.emailNotifications, step.run('send-email') -> sendEmail({ to: profile.email, subject: 'Welcome to Kartiva', react: <WelcomeEmail name={profile.fullName}/> }) + logNotification({ channel:'email', eventType:'welcome', recipient: profile.email, status:'sent'|'failed', providerMessageId, error }); if profile.smsNotifications && profile.phone, step.run('send-sms') -> sendSMS({ to: profile.phone, message: 'Welcome to Kartiva! Your account has been created successfully.' }) + log; if profile.whatsappNotifications && profile.phone, step.run('send-whatsapp') -> sendWhatsApp({ to: profile.phone, template: 'welcome', params: [profile.fullName ?? 'customer'] }) + log.

Create lib/inngest/functions/otp.ts for event 'notification/otp' (payload: { userId, otp }). Same load-profile pattern. Email subject 'Your Kartiva OTP'; SMS message `Your Kartiva OTP is {otp}. Valid for 10 minutes. Do not share it.` (interpolate the otp); WhatsApp template 'otp_verification' with params [otp].

Create lib/inngest/functions/order-confirmed.ts for event 'notification/order.confirmed' (payload: { userId, orderId }). step.run('load-order') to load the order (status, totals, shippingAddress), orderItems, and the profile. Generate the PDF inside a step.run('generate-invoice') using generateInvoicePDF(orderData) (build InvoicePDFProps from the order+items; numeric strings as-is). Email subject 'Your Kartiva order #{orderId} is confirmed' with react <OrderConfirmedEmail .../> and attachments [{ content: pdfBuffer, filename: `invoice-${orderId}.pdf`, contentType: 'application/pdf' }]; SMS `Your Kartiva order #{orderId} has been confirmed. Total: Rs. {total}. Track at {url}` where url = siteConfig.url + '/account/orders' (or '/orders'); WhatsApp template 'order_confirmed' with params [orderId, total, trackingUrl]. Add an idempotency guard: before sending, check notifications_log for an existing 'sent' row for this orderId+eventType+channel and skip that channel if present (prevents double-send when both the verify route and webhook fire for the same order).

Create lib/inngest/functions/order-shipped.ts for event 'notification/order.shipped' (payload: { userId, orderId }). Email subject 'Your Kartiva order #{orderId} has shipped' with <OrderShippedEmail .../> (tracking placeholder); SMS `Your Kartiva order #{orderId} has been shipped. It will arrive soon.`; WhatsApp template 'order_shipped' params [orderId].

Create lib/inngest/functions/order-delivered.ts for event 'notification/order.delivered' (payload: { userId, orderId }). Email subject 'Your Kartiva order #{orderId} delivered' with <OrderDeliveredEmail .../>; SMS `Your Kartiva order #{orderId} has been delivered. Thank you for shopping!`; WhatsApp template 'order_delivered' params [orderId].

Create lib/inngest/functions/order-cancelled.ts for event 'notification/order.cancelled' (payload: { userId, orderId }). Email subject 'Your Kartiva order #{orderId} cancelled' with <OrderCancelledEmail orderId stockRestored />; SMS `Your Kartiva order #{orderId} has been cancelled. Stock has been restored.`; WhatsApp template 'order_cancelled' params [orderId].

Create lib/inngest/functions/refund-processed.ts for event 'notification/refund.processed' (payload: { userId, orderId, amount }). Email subject 'Refund processed for Kartiva order #{orderId}' with <RefundProcessedEmail orderId amount timeline='5-7 business days' />; SMS `Your Kartiva refund for order #{orderId} has been processed. Amount: Rs. {amount}. Expect it in 5-7 business days.`; WhatsApp template 'refund_processed' params [orderId, amount].

Create lib/inngest/functions/index.ts that imports all 7 functions and re-exports them as `export const functions = [welcomeFn, otpFn, orderConfirmedFn, orderShippedFn, orderDeliveredFn, orderCancelledFn, refundProcessedFn]`. Add a comment that the WhatsApp template names (welcome, otp_verification, order_confirmed, order_shipped, order_delivered, order_cancelled, refund_processed) must be created in the Meta Business Manager before WhatsApp sends will succeed.

In every function handler, wrap each channel send+log in its own step.run() and put a try/catch inside it: on failure, logNotification with status 'failed' and the error message, then rethrow only if you want Inngest to retry that step (since retries:3 is set, let the step throw to trigger a retry of that single step). Ensure no client-side code imports these (server-only).
acceptance_criteria: app/api/inngest/route.ts exports GET, POST, PUT via serve({ client, functions }) from 'inngest/next'.
7 Inngest functions exist, each using the 2-arg createFunction({ id, retries: 3, triggers: [{ event }] }, handler) form with per-channel step.run() blocks.
The order.confirmed function generates a PDF via generateInvoicePDF and attaches it to the Resend email.
Each function logs a notifications_log row per channel attempt with status sent/failed and eventType+providerMessageId in the payload jsonb.
Each function respects the user's email/sms/whatsapp opt-in preferences and skips opted-out channels.
`npm run build` completes with zero TypeScript errors.
verification: Run `npm run build` and confirm zero TypeScript/compiler errors (this validates the Inngest 2-arg createFunction signatures, the serve() route, and all template/PDF imports).
